notes: Run runTests.sh from the TYPO3 core checkout root. It starts a container (podman by default, `-b docker` to switch) and runs the suite inside it.

Prefix scripted and non-interactive runs with `CI=true`. It drops the interactive container flags, skips the SIGINT trap, and selects the CI phpstan config. Without a TTY the script also removes the interactive flags on its own, but `CI=true` is the explicit form and the one to use from an agent.
Everything after `--` is handed to the underlying tool unchanged: phpunit for the test suites, npm for `-s npm`, composer for `-s composer`.
While iterating, run a single test file or a single test method instead of a whole suite; a full functional run costs minutes per round.
`./Build/Scripts/runTests.sh -h` lists the suites and option values the checked-out branch actually supports.

options.description: Passthrough to phpunit. A path limits the run to one test file, `--filter <methodName>` to one test method.
Database for `-s functional` and the installer e2e suites. sqlite is the default and the fastest; use mariadb or postgres to reproduce DBMS-specific behaviour.
Database driver, only with `-s functional` on mysql or mariadb.
Specific database version, for example `-d mariadb -i 11.4`.
PHP minor version for the container. Only the versions the branch supports are available; check `-h`.
Dry run for `cgl`, `cglGit`, `cglHeader`, `cglHeaderGit`, and `normalizeXliff`: report issues without modifying files.
Split functional or e2e tests into chunks and run one of them.
Enable xdebug towards a listening IDE (default port 9003) for unit, functional, and installer e2e runs.
Container runtime. podman is the default and docker the fallback.

examples.purpose: One functional test file on the default sqlite database
Functional tests on mariadb, to reproduce a DBMS-specific bug
Coding guidelines of the latest commit only
A composer command inside the core test environment

suites.whenToUse: Use for isolated PHP behavior, utility classes, value objects, and narrow bug fixes.

suites.description: PHP functional tests, sqlite by default.
suites.whenToUse: Use for TYPO3 services, persistence, configuration, authentication, routing, and integration behavior.

suites.description: Checks and fixes coding guideline issues for all core PHP files.
suites.whenToUse: Use before review when PHP formatting or file headers may be affected. Add `-n` to only report.

suites.description: Checks and fixes coding guideline issues in the latest committed patch.
suites.whenToUse: Use for a focused pre-review check after creating a commit. Much faster than a full cgl run.
Use for broad PHP syntax confidence after touching many PHP files.
Use for type-sensitive PHP changes and API contract changes.

suites.description: Lints Services.yaml files with tag parsing enabled.
suites.whenToUse: Use after changing dependency injection wiring in a Configuration/Services.yaml.

suites.description: Checks all .xlf files for validity and deprecated usages.
suites.whenToUse: Use after adding, changing, or retiring XLF labels.
Use after editing XLF files, so the diff carries no formatting noise. Add `-n` to only report.
Use for every changelog entry and other ReST documentation change.

suites.description: Verifies that all .rst files referenced by the extension scanner exist.
suites.whenToUse: Use when a deprecation or breaking change adds extension scanner matchers.

suites.description: Frontend build for TypeScript, Sass, Contrib, and assets.
suites.whenToUse: Use when backend UI assets, TypeScript, Sass, or generated assets change.

suites.whenToUse: Use when Sass or CSS sources change. Internally this runs grunt stylelint in the Build directory.
Use while iterating on Sass/CSS changes when a full frontend build is not needed. This maps to grunt css.
Use when TypeScript or JavaScript code changes.

suites.description: JavaScript unit tests for the built backend modules.
suites.whenToUse: Use for TypeScript modules with real logic or state transitions. Run `-s build` first so the tests see the current output.

suites.description: End-to-end tests driving a real backend with Playwright.
suites.whenToUse: Use for editor or administrator workflows that only break in the assembled backend.

suites.description: Dispatcher for npm commands inside the TYPO3 core build environment.
suites.whenToUse: Use for npm install, audit, build, watch, and package-script tasks.

suites.whenToUse: Use for composer dumpautoload, require, info, and dependency tasks.
